d:
Dive into the timeless romance of this classic song from Kudrat, beautifully sung by Kishore Kumar. Featuring the legendary duo Rajesh Khanna and Hema Malini, and composed by the maestro R.D. Burman, this track remains one of the most cherished old romantic Bollywood songs.
Hamen Tumse Pyar Kitna | Rajesh Khanna, Hema Malini | Kudrat (1981) | RD Burman | Old Romantic Songs
Song: Hamen Tumse Pyar Kitna
Movie: Kudrat (1981)
Star Cast : Rajesh Khanna, Hema Malini
Singer : Kishore Kumar
Music Director: RD Burman
Lyricist: Majrooh Sultanpuri
